text:
Eva (Sales): @Nina quick heads-up — EU HealthTech wants SOC2 artifacts + a signed pen-test attestation for the POC. They also insist on data residency (EU) for PHI. Can we support with Hosted or do we need Dedicated/Private? They want costs for both, and a realistic timeline. POC kickoff targeted Mon next week.
Nina (SolutionsEng): Thanks Eva :wave: Need scope: will PHI be stored at rest? Or only processed in-memory? Also do they require customer-managed KMS / HSM?
Eva (Sales): They say storing encrypted at rest in EU region, retention 90 days, and SSO via SAML (Okta). KMS preference: customer-managed if possible.
Sam (SRE): Short answer: Hosted can be in EU region but not with customer-managed KMS or full isolation. For full tenant isolation + customer KMS we should propose Dedicated or Private. Latency/throughput tiers differ.
Nina (SolutionsEng): For the POC we can do a hosted staging tenant in eu-west1 and sign a pen-test attestation (we provide our controls summary + SOC2 AOC). But if they need 'dedicated GPUs, isolated network, and CMK' then Dedicated is required.
Leo (Security): For the pen-test attestation: we can provide a signed 'pen-test letter' that states Redwood engages periodic third-party penetration testing and summarises scope (external + internal). We cannot share third-party vendor reports, but we can provide an attestation and remediation status. If customer requires a fresh red-team specifically for their workload, that would be a third-party cost to them.
Eva (Sales): Do we have a template for the attestation + SOC2 AOC? Also they asked for an approximate lead time for a Dedicated onboarding (if they pick that).
AuditBot: Uploaded: https://redwood.box.com/s/example-soc2-aoc (SOC2 AOC), https://redwood.box.com/s/pen-test-attestation-template (Pen-test attestation template) :page_facing_up:
Nina (SolutionsEng): Template links good. Quick checklist for POC (suggested):
```
- Provide SOC2 AOC (we give)
- Provide signed pen-test attestation (we give)
- Provide staging creds + SAML test IdP (customer supplies Okta test app)
- Confirm EU region + encryption config (customer/hosted)
- Network ACLs / egress IPs for allowlist
- Estimate Dedicated pricing if they want CMK + isolation
```
Sam (SRE): Dedicated onboarding estimate: 4-6 weeks typical for initial provisioning + certs + network peering. If they accept a hosted POC with our EU tenant (no CMK), we can stand up in 2-3 business days. Pricing: I'll ping infra pricing, but rough ballpark: hosted POC usage billed per-token + dev credits; Dedicated baseline monthly commit roughly ~3-5x hosted for comparable capacity.
Leo (Security): Pen-test attestation content we can provide: statement of testing cadence, scope boundaries, last test date (month/year), known high-level findings resolved. We can sign a customer-specific attestation letter with legal sign-off. If they need a 'signed red-team report' naming them, that triggers third-party engagement.
Eva (Sales): They asked if we can include an SLA addendum during POC. Usually we do short-term SLA for Dedicated only, right?
Nina (SolutionsEng): Correct. Hosted has standard uptime terms in TOS. For anything SLA-backed during POC, we need Dedicated + sales/legal addendum.
Eva (Sales): Ok. Can someone drop a quick one-pager with the options + costs so I can send to customer today? I'll include the SOC2 AOC and attestation template in the email.
Sam (SRE): I'll draft a high-level cost delta: Hosted EU POC (2-3 days) — no CMK, per-usage pricing. Dedicated (4-6w setup) — CMK & isolation, monthly commitment estimate + onboarding fee. Will DM numbers.
Leo (Security): I'll prepare a short attestation letter we can sign (legal cc'd). ETA: EOD today.
Nina (SolutionsEng): I'll prepare a POC runbook (SSO steps, sample manifest, allowlist IPs) and attach the staging config example. ETA: EOD.
Eva (Sales): Perfect, thanks all :thumbsup: I’ll reply to the customer once I have the two docs (cost + runbook + attestation).
Leo (Security): One more note — if they require proof of a SOC2 scope that explicitly lists PHI handling, we need to confirm our SOC2 scope includes customer data processing for inference workloads. I'll check with compliance and update.
AuditBot: Compliance check queued. Ticket #CMP-4521.
Nina (SolutionsEng): For the customer's Okta team: provide them this SAML ACS URL and entity id: `https://poc.eu.redwood.ai/saml/acs` / `urn:redwood:poc:eu`. Also send them test user creds (one-time).
Eva (Sales): Copy. I'll ask the customer to confirm whether they want Hosted EU (fast) or Dedicated (SLA + CMK).
Sam (SRE): FYI — if they go Dedicated we should block calendar for network peering windows next month.
Eva (Sales): Noted. Closing loop after docs land. Thanks everyone.
